description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PP/25/05046 (Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 24/02043 to allow: the addition of a lift over-run and a rooflight to the flat area of the main roof; the addition of 2no. louvred panels on the lower rear elevation; the addition of 3no. windows to the north facing flank elevation, and the relocation of 2no. approved doors; and the addition of 3no. windows to the south facing flank elevation; through the provision of 7no. replacement drawings.) for revised rear openings, with sash windows and French doors replacing approved doors and louvres; painted render to lower ground floor rear extension and to the north flank plinth; new north flank sash window; enlarged garage door opening and repositioned garage rooflights; roof access hatch; side gate to north passage; rendered extractor panel; a low kitchen extract enclosure on main roof, not visible from street.
